sense_motive.name: Sense Motive
sense_motive.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Sense Motive gives +2 on Diplomacy checks and opposes Bluff feints in combat.

actions.name: Assess Gut Hunch on Trustworthiness
actions.description: Form an intuitive assessment of whether a person is trustworthy or harboring hostile intent.

actions.name: Discern Innuendo or Secret Message
actions.description: Detect subtle double entendres, cant, or encrypted hand signals passed between conspirators.
